about_the_game:
Fully produced by Japanese composer ruha, this album features 19 tracks that bring to life the story of Cafe DReAMLAND.
Vibrant, and sometimes just a little bit mystical, enjoy a collection of riveting music capturing the atmosphere of a café filled with the scent of coffee, the ambience of a town lit by an orange dusk, and so much more.

01.Cafe DReAMLAND

02.Abyssal Library

03.Chatty Kitty

04.Sweet Mead Lemonade

05.Sugarless Coffee

06.Mischievous Milkshake

07.Silent Snow

08.Nobody Exists

09.Mythological Mysteries

10.Sunset Soda

11.Stray Cat Town

12.Round n' Round

13.Closed Umbrella

14.Broken Clock

15.Migo Migo Combat!!

16.Storytellers

17.Melty Sugar Cubes

18.I'M BACK, WORLD

19.Someday, Somewhere
